HighLevel: the platform we build on

HighLevel (often called GoHighLevel) is the platform every system we set up runs on: contacts and pipelines, automated email follow-up, calendars and booking, review requests, website chat, and the AI agents that answer calls and chats. We use it for our own business too; our main line is answered by an AI receptionist built on it.

Who it suits

Service businesses whose leads arrive by phone, website forms, chat and social messages, and who want them all in one place with follow-up that runs on its own.

Who it does not suit

A business with a handful of customers a month and no follow-up to automate. It is a lot of system, and it takes time to learn. If you would rather not learn it, that is the job we do.

Try HighLevel (referral link) (opens in a new tab)

ServiceTitan: field service software for the trades

ServiceTitan is software built around crews and trucks: scheduling, dispatching, invoicing and job tracking for home service trades such as HVAC, plumbing and electrical. We list it because trade owners ask us what to run their jobs on, and it is the one we point established shops toward.

Who it suits

Established home service companies running several technicians and trucks, with enough job volume to justify a dedicated system.

Who it does not suit

Owner-operators and very small shops. ServiceTitan does not publish its prices on its website; expect a sales conversation and a demo before you get a quote, and go in knowing your technician count and job volume.

See ServiceTitan (referral link) (opens in a new tab)

Questions about these tools

Do I need to buy HighLevel myself to work with you?

No. When we set up an AI receptionist, chat widget or CRM automation for you, it runs on HighLevel as part of our service and the monthly price covers our work. The referral link on this page is for owners and agencies who want their own HighLevel account to run themselves.

Do you make money from these links?

We may. A signup through a link on this page can pay us a referral fee from the software company, and your price does not change. That is why this is the only page on the site with referral links, and why we tell you who each tool is not for.

Does your AI receptionist connect to ServiceTitan?

We do not promise it in advance. Whether and how an AI receptionist built on HighLevel can pass information to your field service software depends on your account and setup, so we confirm it for your business before we promise anything. Until then, the agent can still answer, collect the details and send them to your team by email.

Hear the AI receptionist answer before you buy one

Call our main line. The AI receptionist that picks up is the same kind of agent we configure for clients, so you can test it with your own questions. Ask it about prices, setup or your industry, or leave a message for Maurice.
